name: Mwila Textiles
bio: A family business bringing bright wax prints and children's fabrics from Lusaka markets to the North West of England.
deliveryInfo: Dispatches within 2 working days from Manchester. UK delivery 2–4 working days.

name: Chanda's Chitenge House
bio: Specialists in traditional Zambian chitenge and heritage colourways, sourced from producers in Lusaka and Kitwe.
deliveryInfo: Dispatches within 1–3 working days from London. Collection available at ZOCF London events.

name: Lusaka Looms Diaspora
bio: Bold geometric chitenge and earthy prints, with a focus on supporting small-scale textile traders.
deliveryInfo: Dispatches within 3 working days from Birmingham. UK delivery 2–5 working days.

name: Bana Bemba Prints
bio: Celebration and wedding fabrics, including matching sets for families and kitchen-party groups.
deliveryInfo: Dispatches within 2 working days from Leeds. Bulk orders for events by arrangement.

name: Copperbelt Fabric Co.
bio: Contemporary African prints and designer pieces inspired by the Copperbelt, shipped across Ireland and the UK.
deliveryInfo: Dispatches within 3 working days from Dublin. Ireland 2–3 working days, UK 3–6 working days.
